To estimate the length of your AI-generated article, pay close attention to the structure of your outline, particularly the number of H2 headings (subheadings) you include. The number of H2 headings is directly proportional to the estimated length of the article; more H2 headings will result in a longer article.

**Where to Find the Length Estimation:**

1. Once you’ve structured your outline with H2 headings, go to the “Generate AI Article” button. You can find it at the bottom of the “Build your brief” section.
2. Just below this button, you will find the estimated length of your article. This estimation provides a rough guide to its extent based on the current structure of your outline.

![SEOwind AI Article Length Estimation](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/AALE1-1024x550.png)

**Important Note:**

- If you have not created an outline or your outline does not contain any H2 or H3 headings, the estimation information will not be available. It’s essential to structure your outline with H2 headings to activate this feature.

This estimation feature is designed to help you gauge the depth and breadth of your article before generation, allowing for better planning and adjustments to meet your content goals.
